Required Action: Review features for potential proxy effects, justify feature necessity, and document mitigations.
Blockers / Dependencies: Feature inventory and relevant data access; lawful and appropriate group analysis.
Required Closure Evidence: Feature inventory and justification; documented proxy analysis and methodology; mitigation testing where applicable; approved residual-risk decision.
Closure Reviewer: Independent Model Validation / designated governance reviewer
Production Gate: Must be resolved or explicitly handled through an authorised risk decision before production approval.

Required Action: Define target, positive class, false-positive/false-negative formulas, denominators, evaluation population, and uncertainty methodology.
Blockers / Dependencies: Agreement on model target, prediction horizon, reference outcomes, and evaluation population.
Required Closure Evidence: Approved metric specification; reproducible evaluation methodology; documented population and subgroup counts; results with uncertainty and limitations; independent methodology review.
Closure Reviewer: Independent reviewer not responsible for producing the evaluation
Production Gate: Do not rely on fairness/error-rate results until definitions and methodology are approved and reproducible.

Finding: Label reliability and selection bias are uncertain
Required Action: Review label provenance, outcome maturity, rejected-applicant limitations, and selection effects.
Blockers / Dependencies: Access to label definitions, source lineage, outcome observation windows, and historical approval process documentation.
Required Closure Evidence: Label provenance and quality report; selection-bias analysis; documented limitations and assumptions; independently reviewed evaluation approach.
Production Gate: Evaluation must justify the use and limitations of labels; unresolved limitations must remain visible in the risk decision.

Required Action: Define reviewer authority, override rules, escalation, audit logging, and decision workflow.
Blockers / Dependencies: Confirmed end-to-end lending workflow and reviewer roles.
Required Closure Evidence: Approved Human Oversight Matrix; documented review and escalation procedure; training records; synthetic workflow test results; sample audit-log evidence.
Production Gate: Meaningful review, challenge, override, and escalation capability must be operationally defined and tested.

Required Action: Analyse data coverage, missingness, subgroup representation, and data quality.
Blockers / Dependencies: Documented data sources, collection periods, markets, applicant populations, and lawful access to relevant data.
Required Closure Evidence: Data-quality report; coverage and representativeness analysis; documented limitations and remediation; approved data-quality monitoring plan.
Production Gate: Material data-quality and coverage issues must be resolved or assessed with documented limitations and appropriate controls.

Required Action: Investigate observed disparities using validated metrics and predefined criteria.
Blockers / Dependencies: F-002 metric specification and relevant F-003/F-005 label and data-quality analysis.
Required Closure Evidence: Reproducible subgroup evaluation report; root-cause analysis; mitigation comparison; independent validation findings; documented residual-risk assessment.
Closure Reviewer: Independent Model Validation / designated governance authority
Production Gate: Material disparities must be investigated and mitigated as appropriate; remaining risks must be explicitly assessed by an authorised decision-maker.

Finding: Automatic rejection or gating is unverified
Required Action: Inspect the actual workflow and test that automatic actions cannot bypass the approved human decision process.
Blockers / Dependencies: Access to system configuration, thresholds, integrations, downstream workflows, and test environment.
Required Closure Evidence: Documented workflow/configuration review; synthetic test cases and results; evidence preventing unapproved automatic actions; updated inventory if actual behaviour differs from stated design.
Closure Reviewer: Credit Risk + Engineering Control Owner / AI Governance
Production Gate: Actual workflow must match the approved design; unintended automatic decision pathways must be removed or appropriately governed.
